name: Tethercam
subtitle: iPhone as a Windows webcam over USB
description: Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) app that turns your iPhone into a full-resolution webcam for Windows 11 over a USB cable. Install the Windows side from the MSI on the GitHub releases page.

apps.name: Tethercam
apps.subtitle: Use your iPhone as a webcam on Windows over USB
apps.localizedDescription:
Tethercam streams your iPhone camera to a Windows 11 PC over the USB cable, at up to 4K 60 fps, where it shows up as a normal webcam in Teams, Zoom, OBS, browsers and the Camera app. No account, no watermark, no Wi-Fi.

You also need the Windows app (MSI) from https://github.com/kshitizwagle/tethercam/releases and Apple Devices (Microsoft Store) on the PC.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tethercam streams your camera to your PC over the USB cable.
